name: Hoshino Sayaka
source:
A 1st year middle schooler.
An anxious girl who isn't good at being around people.
She loves acting, but because of her condition she cant seem to move forward with her dream.
She met [url=/c51801]Hikaru[/url] at the entrance ceremony and was charmed by his personality.
translation:
A 1st year middle schooler.
An anxious girl who isn't good at being around people.
She loves acting, but because of her condition she cant seem to move forward with her dream.
She met [url=/c51801]Hikaru[/url] at the entrance ceremony and was charmed by his personality.
